Do you love turning data into insights that drive better commercial decisions? Are you motivated by working at the intersection of merchandising, inventory and performance?

We are looking for a Specialist, Merchandise Controlling & OTB - Interim to join our Global Merchandise Controlling & OTB team.

In this role, you will be at the heart of Pandora’s merchandise planning process. You will support global planning and reporting, analyse performance and inventory, and help turn complex data into clear insights that support commercial decisions and future buys.

Working across clusters and global teams, you will play an important role in connecting sell-out, sell-in and inventory planning while identifying risks and opportunities along the way.

**Your Key Responsibilities

****Merchandise Controlling & Reporting

**

• Support the consolidation of top-down merchandise financial plans across assigned clusters.

• Analyse cluster assumptions and identify potential risks, gaps and opportunities.

• Support reporting across key commercial metrics including sell-out, revenue, units, ASP and sell-in.

• Conduct performance and variance analysis against budget, forecast and last year.

• Develop and maintain dashboards and reporting tools that enable better decision-making.

• Use AI-enabled tools to strengthen analysis, spot trends and generate actionable insights.

**Inventory & Sell-In Planning

**

• Develop and maintain sell-in plans aligned with inventory guidelines, stock coverage targets and commercial priorities.

• Adjust plans based on the latest sell-out expectations, inventory positions, product flows and commercial developments.

• Monitor inventory health and identify areas requiring action.

• Partner with cluster and global merchandising teams to challenge assumptions and ensure alignment between sell-out, sell-in and inventory plans.

**Business Partnering & Continuous Improvement

**

• Collaborate closely with Finance, Supply Chain, Inventory Strategy, Merchandise Planning, Demand Planning and Allocation.

• Help maintain consistent and accurate planning assumptions across commercial and operational teams.

• Contribute to improving planning, reporting and analytical processes.

• Explore new tools, methodologies and AI-enabled solutions that can make business steering more efficient and insightful.

**What We’re Looking For

**You are naturally analytical and enjoy getting into the detail, but you can also step back and understand the bigger commercial picture. You are structured, proactive and comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where priorities can evolve.

Just as importantly, you enjoy collaborating with others and building strong relationships across teams and markets.

**Ideally, You Bring

**

• A bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Economics, International Business or a related field.

• 2+ years of experience within Merchandising, Supply Chain or Controlling.

• Strong commercial and analytical capabilities, with advanced Excel skills.

• Experience working with and interpreting large datasets.

• A solid understanding of inventory and planning principles, including stock coverage, replenishment and inventory health.

• Strong communication and presentation skills.

• A collaborative mindset and the ability to work effectively across functions.

• Experience using AI-enabled tools to improve analysis and efficiency.

• Experience from retail, fashion or FMCG is a strong advantage, while exposure to a global organisation is also beneficial.

**Your new team

**You will join the Global Merchandise Controlling & OTB team, currently consisting of three managers and four specialists. You will work in a highly cross-functional environment with plenty of opportunities to collaborate across the organisation, develop your commercial understanding and make an impact on how we plan and manage our global merchandise business.

Additional **information

**

• Global Career Band 5B

• Interim (12 months contract)

**Did we get your attention?

**If you see yourself in the position and would like to become part of Pandora’s future, please do not hesitate to apply. We look forward to hearing from you!

We process applications on a continuous basis, which is why we encourage you to send your application as soon as possible.

You can also read more about Pandora on our corporate site.

**About Pandora

**Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion (EUR 4.4 billion) in 2025.

Recognised by the Financial Times as one of Europe’s Best Workplaces and ranked #1 among Danish companies, Pandora is committed to building an inclusive and diverse workplace. We believe that reflecting the diversity of society in how we engage with our customers is essential to fulfilling our purpose: to give a voice to people’s loves. We are dedicated to nurturing a culture where everyone feels respected, valued, and empowered to thrive.

jobs.description:
Do you want to be a valued part of the critical infrastructure that serves communities across Europe and beyond? Are you looking for a position in which you can set direction and help shape our company? If so, then you could be the newest addition to our Commercial Excellence team as Head of Pricing Excellence & Commercial Insights.

At DFDS, we are strengthening how we use pricing, customer data and commercial insights to improve profitability, support growth and create greater value for our customers.

As Head of Pricing Excellence & Commercial Insights, you will play a key role in this transformation. You will drive the development of pricing capabilities, help establish a stronger customer data foundation and turn commercial data into actionable insights that support decision-making across the business.

You will join our Commercial Excellence team, which works across DFDS to enable more efficient, data-driven and profitable commercial operations. Through common tools, processes and insights, we help strengthen commercial performance while supporting local business ownership and flexibility.

Be part of the movement - and play your part.

About The Role As Head of Pricing Excellence & Commercial Insights, you will own and drive DFDS' pricing excellence and commercial insights agenda across a complex, international business.

This is a highly strategic role focused on strengthening pricing capabilities, improving commercial decision-making, and unlocking value from customer and commercial data. Working across business units and functions, you will lead key transformation initiatives, establish scalable frameworks and best practices, and drive the adoption of tools, processes, and data-driven ways of working.

Operating in a highly decentralized organisation, you will balance the implementation of common standards and governance with the need for local ownership and commercial flexibility.

Pricing Excellence and Commercial Insights is an area of increasing strategic importance and executive attention. You will play a key role in elevating its maturity and impact, working closely with Commercial leadership, Data & Technology, Customer Engagement, Tender Management, and Tools & Processes to deliver measurable business value.

**Key priorities

**

• Drive the Pricing Excellence strategy across business units, establishing governance, standards and best practices while enabling local flexibility

• Own the business vision and roadmap for our pricing platform, ensuring continuous development, adoption and value creation

• Lead the digitalisation of pricing processes across CRM, contract management and pricing solutions

• Build and mature Commercial Insights capabilities, transforming data into actionable recommendations and commercial decision support

• Shape the long-term strategy for our customer data foundation in partnership with Data & Technology

• Identify opportunities to improve profitability and reduce revenue leakage through analytics, automation and AI

• Facilitate alignment, collaboration and knowledge sharing across business units and senior stakeholders

• Translate complex data and insights into clear recommendations for management and commercial leadership

**About You

**At DFDS, we believe the strongest teams are built through diverse perspectives, experiences and ways of thinking.

With this in mind, we think that you are a strategic and commercially minded professional who enjoys solving complex problems and turning insights into action. You combine strong analytical capabilities with the ability to influence stakeholders, challenge existing ways of working and drive change across a matrix organisation.

You thrive at the intersection of business, data and technology and are motivated by creating tangible commercial impact through pricing excellence, customer insights and continuous improvement.

We think the ideal person for this position will bring the following:

• 5+ years of relevant experience within Pricing, Commercial Excellence, Revenue Management, Strategy, Management Consulting, Business Development, Finance, Analytics or a related field

• A strong track record of driving cross-functional initiatives and delivering results through collaboration and influence rather than formal authority

• Experience operating in complex organisations with multiple stakeholders and competing priorities

• A strategic mindset combined with the ability to translate ideas and opportunities into practical solutions and business outcomes

• Experience working with commercial tools and platforms such as CRM, pricing, CPQ, contract management or business intelligence solutions

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to turn data into actionable insights and recommendations

• Interest in leveraging data, automation and AI to improve commercial performance and decision-making

• The ability to communicate complex topics clearly and confidently to both operational teams and senior stakeholders

• A curiosity for understanding customers, commercial processes and business drivers, combined with a willingness to challenge the status quo

Working at DFDS

While you’re with us, we want you to develop. At DFDS, development happens first and foremost through real work. We will also offer training and support when needed.

We promote a great workplace with a diverse and vibrant community. At our Copenhagen headquarters, we enjoy a modern workspace with award-winning facilities, different work zones, own game room, fitness facilities, canteen and a café with a rooftop terrace with a beautiful ocean view, all just 5 minutes from the nearest train & metro station.

Are we a match? Then what are you waiting for? Apply Now.

If you think your personality, skills, experience, and aspirations match this role, we’d love to hear from you. Please submit your application as soon as possible, as we’re keen to meet potential candidates on an ongoing basis.

**We look forward to hearing from you.

**This recruitment process is managed by the DFDS Talent Acquisition team. We kindly ask external recruitment agencies to refrain from contacting us regarding this opportunity.

Ambu is currently looking for a Solution Architect to join our GI & Urology solutions team in Global R&D. As a Solutions Architect within our Research and Development (R&D) team at Ambu, you will play a key role in designing and implementing innovative solutions that advance our single use endoscopy solutions. This role requires a blend of technical expertise, strategic thinking, and collaboration skills to drive the development of cutting-edge solutions that meet the needs of our customers and contribute to the growth and success of our organization.

Apply today and join us for a career #ForeverForward!

In our global R&D team, where we develop medical devices, we have a great culture and a clear focus on bringing products to the market that are based on a thorough understanding of the customer's needs. We focus on developing customer centric products that combine several technologies in new and innovative ways. This role requires exceptional architectural skills, a deep understanding of both business and technical aspects, and solid medical device experience.

Your main responsibilities will include:

• Engage with key stakeholders, including customers, partners, and internal teams to understand requirements and translate them into actionable technical solutions.

• Collaborate closely with product management to define product roadmaps and prioritize feature development based on customer needs and market opportunities.

• Participate in and support early phase investigations and exploratory research initiatives aimed at identifying new opportunities and technologies for potential integration into future product offerings.

• Collaborate with R&D subject matter experts and teams to conduct feasibility studies, prototype development, and proof-of-concept demonstrations to assess the viability and potential impact of emerging technologies on medical device innovation.

• Provide technical expertise and guidance to inform decision-making processes during the evaluation and selection of technologies for inclusion in future product roadmaps, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives and market needs.

• Support early-stage new product development projects with solution architecture.

• Stay abreast of emerging technologies and industry trends to inform solution architecture decisions and drive innovation within the organization.

• Lead the architecture of complex solutions combining mechanical, electronics and software for our medical technology products and services, considering factors such as scalability, security, reliability, sustainability, and performance.

• Provide technical leadership and guidance to development teams throughout the solution lifecycle, ensuring adherence to architectural best practices and alignment with organizational goals.

• Mentor and coach team members on architectural principles, design patterns, and standards to foster a culture of excellence and continuous improvement.

• Continuously monitor and evaluate existing solutions to identify opportunities for optimization to improve scalability, efficiency, and maintainability.

Suggested candidate profile Skills and experiences can be earned in many different ways, and we understand that the best fit for the role cannot be prescribed on paper. You are, however, likely to succeed in this position if you:

• Hold a master’s degree in engineering and have technical work experience.

• Proven experience as a Solutions Architect or similar role in a medical technology or healthcare environment.

• In-depth knowledge of relevant technologies and platforms for single use medical devices.

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively engage with stakeholders at all levels and articulate complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences.

• Demonstrated leadership abilities with a track record of successfully leading cross-functional teams and driving projects to completion.

• Creative problem-solving skills and a passion for innovation, coupled with a strong commitment to quality and customer satisfaction.

• Strong team player and collaborative skills in a cross functional and international setting

It is a requirement that you are fluent in oral and written English.

**Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter

**Ambu is a company that expands rapidly and has ambitious growth targets. We meet these targets through interdisciplinary teamwork between motivated and highly skilled employees. Your contributions and efforts are crucial to our success and by joining us you will get the opportunity to work in an international head office with an informal working environment.

We offer great opportunities for personal development. Furthermore, we offer a wide range of professional, social and financial employee benefits in addition to exciting job challenges and continuous professional and personal development.

Join us and help shape PtX (Power-to-X) and BtX (Bio-to-X) projects on a global scale, working with an experienced team on the solutions of the future.

At Blue Power Partners, we are a global consultancy and project development company dedicated to delivering renewable energy solutions that support sustainable change. Our core expertise is conceptual design and economic modeling of entire complexes, including wind and solar farms, power sourcing, and downstream PtX and BtX facilities.

We work closely with our clients, who include one of the world’s largest fund managers in greenfield renewable energy.

**About the job

**We are looking for an experienced Senior Process Engineer to contribute to the development of PtX and BtX facilities worldwide. You will join a team of skilled specialists in a role with a wide variety of tasks. The key deliverables are due diligence, feasibility analysis, and initial conceptual design.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Leading process development, including feasibility studies and pre-FEED, and sharing your process expertise as a technical advisor

• Working with our modeling team on techno-economic optimization by providing technical and economic input

• Taking part in technical classification meetings, exhibit reviews, and negotiations

• Supporting proposals, tender processes, safety assessments, and plant commissioning

• Helping develop in-house tools, such as techno-economic calculation models, to support concept design and benchmarking of PtX and BtX projects

• Coordinating across project disciplines and stakeholders

• Managing third-party verification

• Contributing to knowledge sharing and smooth project delivery

You will work from our office in Copenhagen (Tromsøgade 2, Nordhavn) or Aalborg HQ (John F. Kennedys Plads 43). Because we work globally, the role sometimes calls for flexibility, and we offer the same in return.

**About you

**You are curious and enjoy learning. You like working in a structured, thoughtful way, and you thrive in an international, multicultural environment where adaptability and teamwork matter.

We are looking for someone who brings:

• An MSc in chemical engineering or another relevant engineering field

• Around 10 years of experience with chemical processes

• Strong process experience, including PFDs, process modeling tools (e.g., Aspen HYSYS, DWSIM), equipment design, P&IDs, and process safety

• A solid understanding of thermodynamics, reaction engineering, fluid flow, heat transfer, and mass transfer

• Hands-on experience with one or more PtX or BtX production processes, such as electrolysis, steam methane reforming (SMR), Haber-Bosch, methanol synthesis, methanation, synthesis of higher hydrocarbons (SAF), refinery processes, biomass processing, carbon capture, or CO2 sequestration

• Good collaboration and organizational skills

• Fluent written and spoken English

**Contact

**For more information about the position, please contact Anne Krog Jensen, Head of PtX & Molecules, at akj@bluepp.dk.

To apply, upload your resume through our recruitment system via the “Apply” link. We don’t accept applications by email.

**Why join Blue Power Partners?

**At Blue Power Partners, we value belonging, purpose, and diverse perspectives, and we believe they contribute to our innovation and long-term success. Our organization is built on trust, entrepreneurship, and balance. You will join a focused team working on specialized technical projects, where you can grow your expertise in PtX and BtX. Joining BPP means becoming part of a consultancy that is contributing to the energy transition, with strong technical roots and an international scope.

jobs.description:
Meet your team

[

Devoteam always offers you new opportunities to make you learn, expand your knowledge and evolve in your career path

Discover Layal’s story

](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OUqqJ_5rdl0&feature=youtu.be)

Job Description

Strategy & Digital Business Design is the Copenhagen strategy team inside Devoteam, a company of more than 11,000 tech professionals, around 350 of them here in Denmark.

Most companies by now have more AI ideas, pilots and PoCs than they know what to do with. We help them focus on the few problem spaces that matter, and we stay until the solutions create real value in the business.

We’re hiring one or more Lead Strategy Consultants. It’s a senior role. You run your own workstreams, you lead other consultants on them, and you’re comfortable in a room with the client’s leadership team without someone more senior next to you.

The work:

Most of our engagements start with a question like “where should we place our AI bets, and what are they worth?” From there, you’ll do AI strategy and readiness work with business leaders, shape the first use cases and pilot teams, and make sure the solutions make it past the PoC stage and into the business. Sometimes you’ll even build them yourself. We judge our work by the value it creates for the client. If a solution isn’t moving the numbers that matter, we challenge it and keep adjusting until it does, or we stop it. We expect everyone to go deep enough on the technology to test what models can and can’t do and hold their own with architects and engineers.

We work across industries, but we’re investing most in life sciences (pharma in particular) and manufacturing, where we are scaling our industry depth and experience.

What we’re looking for:

• 
Around 5 to 6 years in consulting, at a firm or in-house. Long enough to have structured problem solving in your bones, and to know when to ignore the frameworks or develop something new.

• 
You’ve run workstreams from scoping to delivery, with a team and a client, and you know how to manage upwards on both sides.

• 
You think in business value. You can put a number on what a solution is worth, and you keep pushing until it delivers.

• 
You’re the one who asks the awkward question in the steering committee, and you can back it up.

• 
You’re obsessively curious. You want to understand how things work, and you’ve usually gone down the rabbit hole before anyone asked you to.

• 
You use AI to work faster, but most importantly you still do the thinking yourself.

• 
Experience from life sciences or manufacturing is a clear plus.

• 
Fluent English. Danish is a bonus.

If you come from the build side:

We also want to hear from people who took a different route. If you’re an engineer or data scientist who ended up spending most of your time with the business, and you’ve built agents, data products or prototypes side by side with the people using them, please apply as well!

Why us?

• 
We’re on top of the newest AI tools, and they’re part of how we work and what we deliver. When something better comes out on a Tuesday, we’re using it by Thursday.

• 
Your ideas will be tested hard and either built or put down (nicely, of course).

• 
You’ll work with some of the largest companies in the Nordics on problems where AI changes the numbers.

• 
You’ll help shape our offerings and the methods behind them, especially in life sciences and manufacturing.

• 
You’re in charge of how you work. Work from home when it suits you. What we care about is that you grow and that our clients get results.

• 
We are a small team of ambitious people who like to spend time together both on and off work. We have various social events, we regularly have breakfast or dinner together and enjoy sharing knowledge on new AI tools, travel tips or anything else that we are passionate about.

How to apply:

Send your CV and half a page, or a two-minute video, answering two questions:

• 
Pick a company you know well. Where will AI change its economics most in the next three years, and what would you do first?

• 
What’s something technical you taught yourself, and why?

If you’re from the build side, send a link to something you’ve made and a few lines on what it taught you.

The interviews include a case. You’ll work through a client problem like the ones we see, and show us how you’d get from the question to something that works.

Skip the cover letter. Your answers tell us more.

Shift4 (NYSE: FOUR) is boldly redefining commerce by simplifying complex payments ecosystems across the world. As the leader in commerce-enabling technology, Shift4 powers billions of transactions annually for hundreds of thousands of businesses in virtually every industry. For more information, visit www.shift4.com.

**What You Will Do. A Glimpse Into Your Role

**As Managing Director Denmark at Global Blue by Shift4, you will oversee one of the company’s leanest but most dynamic organizations, operating in a highly competitive environment centred around Copenhagen and Kastrup Airport refund operations. You will combine strategic leadership with a hands-on operational approach, ensuring excellence in day-to-day activities while driving long-term growth.

You will work closely with your manager to shape and implement the country strategy, while actively engaging with merchants, airport stakeholders, Customs (SKAT) and your internal teams across both Tax Free and Payment, an area expected to become increasingly important in Denmark over the coming months and years. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a versatile position, balancing commercial development, operational oversight and strategic execution within a Nordic market that demands agility, strong relationships and a strong focus on market-share defence.

**Main Responsibilities

**Your responsibilities will span both strategic and operational dimensions, including:

**Strategic & Business Leadership

**

• Develop, implement and execute business strategies to achieve short- and long-term goals.

• Drive market growth by hunting new merchant partnerships in Payment and farming existing relationships in Tax Free Shopping, defending the established market position.

• Prepare business plans to improve cost-efficiency and operational performance.

• Lead strategy reviews and business development initiatives, identifying opportunities in current and new segments.

**Operational & Team Management

**

• Ensure excellence in airport refund operations, coordinating closely with the Refund Manager and refund agents.

• Support and supervise Key Account Managers in merchant management and sales activities, while maintaining hands-on management of your own merchant portfolio.

• Address day-to-day operational issues with merchants, including IT-related matters.

• Manage hiring, terminations, salary reviews and bonus decisions in alignment with line management.

**Stakeholder Management

**

• Maintain strong relationships with business partners, authorities and key stakeholders, including Customs, airports, merchants, tourism associations and government bodies.

• Negotiate with airport authorities on operational contracts and collaborations.

**Governance & Compliance

**

• Ensure compliance with all relevant laws, rules and company policies.

• Provide monthly reports, market insights and strategic advice to upper management.

• Oversee internal and external communications and key business documentation.

**Every action has an impact. You will make a difference here if:

**

• You thrive in a role that combines strategy with operational involvement and are comfortable getting your hands dirty when needed.

• You bring strong leadership, motivating diverse teams and leading by example.

• You can diagnose business issues quickly and take decisive actions when performance deviates from expectations.

• You build trusted relationships with merchants, institutions and partners, acting as the face of Global Blue in Denmark.

• You can manage multiple business functions simultaneously while keeping strategic priorities clear.

• You bring a dynamic and proactive approach to your work.

**Key competencies to empower your journey.

****You’ll Drive Towards Success If

**

• You demonstrate sharp business judgment, strong analytical skills and the ability to work with business intelligence and big data to identify opportunities.

• You are skilled in negotiation, contract management and partnership development.

• You excel in communication and interpersonal relations, both internally and externally.

• You show excellent organizational and leadership capabilities, including crisis management and decision-making under pressure.

• You have solid financial competencies, being able to use dashboards and reporting systems to drive performance.

• You are proficient in MS Office and used to working with ERP, CRM and financial/reporting systems.

• You are agile and able to make quick decisions, particularly in the fast-moving Payment environment.

• Knowledge of the Point of Sale (POS) IT landscape would be an advantage.

• You have a good understanding of the local Danish retail, merchant and Payment ecosystem.

• Fluent English is required.

**WHY WORK AT JOE & THE JUICE

**JOE & THE JUICE is a people-centric food and beverage company built around culture, offering much more than just juice, sandwiches, and coffee.

We believe in four simple virtues that shape everything we do:

• Positive Attitude

• Inclusion

• Social Ties

• Growth

For us, this means that when you choose a cup-half-full mindset, welcome people from every background, build real friendships across the teams by creating or helping create great guest experiences, and use every day as a chance to learn something new, you become more than just a Juicer or staff member; like us, you continue to search and find purpose and meaning in what you do.

From your first day, you'll be part of an international network of people who support each other, celebrate wins together, and push each other to grow. You'll learn by doing and move through our Moneyball career path—our internal system that tracks your performance and fast-tracks you toward promotion. Most of our leaders have earned their stripes behind the bar (fun fact: over 75% of our employees started as Juicers!), so you will always be part of a company built on that same journey. If you love a fast-paced environment, music, and people, and you like the idea of turning a job into a lifestyle, JOE can become a place to build skills, friendships, and a career that takes you across cities, countries, and roles.

**JOB SUMMARY

**The OTC Supervisor leads the Order-to-Cash team and owns the quality, speed and control of our cash application, collections and reconciliation processes. The role has a special focus on reconciling card payments and delivery platform settlements across a high-volume, multi-location F&B business. You lead and develop the team, safeguard accurate month-end close deliverables, and drive standardisation and automation of OTC processes in Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations. The role reports to the Global OTC Manager.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

**_People and team leadership

_

• Lead, coach and develop the OTC team, plan workload and the close calendar, and ensure timely, high-quality delivery

_Reconciliation and cash application

_

• Own the daily, weekly and monthly reconciliation of card acquirer, payment provider and delivery platform settlements against POS data, bank and the general ledger

• Ensure differences, chargebacks, fees and missing settlements are resolved, including follow-up with external partners

• Ensure correct cash application, customer and franchise/B2B invoicing, collections and aged debt follow-up in Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations

_Close, control and reporting

_

• Ensure accurate balance sheet reconciliations, specifications and reporting for month-end, quarter-end and year-end close

• Support month-end close through AR and line of credit reconciliations and review of the allowance for doubtful accounts

• Safeguard internal controls and audit readiness, and report KPIs such as unmatched items and days to cash to management

_Process improvement and collaboration

_

• Drive standardisation, harmonisation and automation of OTC processes across markets

• Partner with Store Operations, Treasury, Accounting, IT and payment and delivery partners, and advise the business on OTC topics

• Act as a key member of cross-functional teams to improve the flow of data and reporting

**WHO YOU ARE

**

• You take ownership of your workload, manage moderately complex tasks, and help improve processes

• You work independently, propose solutions, and adapt quickly when priorities shift

• Your solid knowledge makes you a dependable contributor who helps drive team performance

**WHAT YOU'LL BRING

**

• +6 years in Order-to-Cash, accounts receivable or revenue accounting, incl. team lead experience

• Experience from retail, F&B, restaurant or hospitality with many locations

• Hands-on experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations

• Proven experience reconciling card payments (e.g. Adyen, Nets/Nexi, Worldline) and delivery platforms (e.g. Wolt, Uber Eats, Just Eat) to POS, bank and GL

• Strong accounting, process and Excel skills; degree in finance, accounting or business administration

• Fluent English (Danish is an advantage)

**OUR BENEFITS

**We offer a benefits package that includes a paid pension plan, health insurance, parental leave, and additional vacation. Besides that, we provide some JOE-ified benefits:

• Our global headquarters is conveniently located in the heart of beautiful Copenhagen, where over 200 friendly faces come together!

• Fantastic office facilities, including a fully staffed JOE & THE JUICE bar, where we serve delicious breakfast, daily lunch, refreshing juices, and top-notch barista coffee.

• At JOE, we embrace a flat hierarchy that values every opinion, creating a welcoming space for your ideas and suggestions to thrive.

• Lively monthly social calendar filled with fun activities like running club, wine tasting, creative evenings, and Friday bars - there's always something exciting happening!

• As part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to take on a BTC (Behind the Counter) shift in one of our bars twice a year, adding a unique touch to your experience.

Employment type: Full-Time

Ready to turn a job into a lifestyle?

**ABOUT JOE & THE JUICE

**Founded in Copenhagen in 2002, JOE & THE JUICE has grown into a global fast-casual concept with more than 500 locations across 25+ countries and over 7,000 employees worldwide, with our sights set on 1,000 stores by 2028.

Our people-centric culture and sustainability agenda are part of our Nordic heritage, and remain central to our commitment to a better future. Along the way, internal workshops and mentorship sharpen your skills, while exchange programs and international assignments can take you across our markets.

Ready to embark on this exciting journey? Apply today and become a part of JOE & THE JUICE!

Are you passionate about renewable energy and eager to work at the forefront of the global energy transition? PEAK Wind is seeking an AI Engineer to help shape our AI roadmap and to build and orchestrate the agents our colleagues and clients will use every day. At PEAK Wind, AI is moving from prototypes into production, and renewable energy operations produce exactly the kind of complex, high-volume data where AI can deliver significant value.

Introducing the Data & Intelligence Team

You will become part of our Data & Intelligence (D&I) team, where we work within PEAK Wind’s asset management service offering and manage full value chain data management for our clients. We support renewable energy assets worldwide through data management, reporting solutions, analytics, and AI capabilities, helping deliver data-driven solutions that support our clients and renewable energy projects. Our team consists of highly motivated professionals who bring diverse backgrounds and a strong commitment to excellence. We support one another, share knowledge, and celebrate both individual and collective achievements.

You will report to the Head of Data & Intelligence and work day-to-day with our small team of engineers who have been building internal AI products at PEAK Wind for several years. You will work closely with colleagues across different areas, bringing your perspective to a collaborative and purposeful team environment.

How You Will Make an Impact

As an AI Engineer, you will take AI solutions from idea to production and keep them there. You will co-own our AI roadmap: helping decide which agents we build, in what order, and what “working” means for each of them. Then you will build them.

Our agent portfolio serves two audiences. What Will Make You Successful in This Role

• A degree in a relevant field such as Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, or similar, or an equivalent track record of shipping software

• Strong Python and/or TypeScript, and hands-on experience with at least one agent framework

• Experience building in cloud environments, preferably Microsoft Azure; familiarity with PostgreSQL, APIs, and modern web stacks is an advantage

• Professional experience in the energy industry or another complex technical environment; renewable energy or SCADA experience is an advantage but not required

• The ability to stay calm and constructive in a high-paced environment

• A collaborative mindset and the ability to thrive in an international, cross-functional team

This role is designed for an engineer who has already gained some hands-on experience building AI solutions and is now looking to deepen that expertise in a highly practical, production-focused environment and enjoys building and learning.

Why Join PEAK Wind

• A real mandate to build with AI: an existing roadmap, internal users who want what you build, and clients ready to adopt it

• An international, inclusive, and diverse workplace where differences are valued

• The opportunity to work on leading renewable energy projects alongside experienced industry professionals

Our Commitment to Inclusion and Fair Hiring

Our hiring decisions focus on what each person brings to the role and our team, and we are committed to ensuring transparent salary structures, with pay decisions based on clear, objective, and gender‑neutral criteria. How to Apply

Please apply directly through our website. If you have any questions or would like to know more about the position, please contact People & Development at recruitment@peak-wind.com.

PEAK Wind is an independent renewable energy specialist in commercial, financial, and technical operations, delivering advisory, intelligence, and asset management services to investors and developers around the world. Job title: Senior Research Scientist – Discovery Pharmacology

Department: Global Research

Location: Måløv, Denmark

**Your impact begins here

**As Senior Research Scientist – Discovery Pharmacology, you will help build a new interdisciplinary team in Global Research that generates and validates therapeutic concepts in cardiometabolic disease and healthspan. You will combine hands-on rodent pharmacology with original scientific thinking, shaping research questions and turning emerging biology into opportunities for drug discovery. Your work will bring new projects into the early discovery pipeline, because lasting health starts with the science we build today.

**What You Will Bring

**You hold a PhD in pharmacology, physiology, neuroscience or a related discipline, or bring equivalent relevant research experience. You also bring:

• At least two years of relevant post-PhD experience with scientific innovation, or equivalent scientific contributions.

• Hands-on experience in rodent pharmacology.

• Strong skills in experimental design, quantitative analysis and interpretation of complex biological data.

• Scientific depth in metabolic physiology, neuroscience, in vitro pharmacology, or a related area.

• Original scientific thinking, intellectual curiosity and the ability to turn ideas into testable hypotheses.

• A collaborative approach and the ability to work independently while contributing to shared research goals.

• Clear scientific communication in written and spoken English.

**Useful, But Not Essential

**Experience in metabolic phenotyping, advanced behavioural assays, rodent surgery, modern neuroscience methods, in vitro or ex vivo approaches, or developing novel experimental technologies. We welcome complementary profiles – you are not expected to bring expertise in every method or scientific area.

**What You Will Do

**You will contribute to both the scientific direction and hands-on experimental work of the team. Your responsibilities will include:

• Generate hypotheses and propose new therapeutic concepts grounded in biological understanding.

• Design, conduct, analyse and interpret mouse and rat pharmacology studies to investigate efficacy, mechanism of action and physiological responses.

• Develop experimental models and introduce methodologies that enable us to address challenging scientific questions.

• Connect in vivo findings with relevant in vitro and ex vivo experiments.

• Integrate evidence into recommendations on how emerging concepts should advance, change direction or be discontinued.

• Document and communicate findings, sharing scientific insights across disciplines and project teams.

• Contribute to rigorous, reproducible experimental practice and high standards of animal welfare.

All scientists are expected to contribute directly to experimental work alongside laboratory technicians and fellow scientists.

**Who You Will Work With

**You will join a new interdisciplinary team in Global Research within Research & Development, combining expertise in physiology, pharmacology, neuroscience and molecular innovation. Day to day, you will work closely with scientists and laboratory technicians. The team, headed by Christoffer Clemmensen, is currently recruiting at multiple levels, so you contribute to shape the new team from the onset.

You are expected to establish close collaborations across the organisation with colleagues in chemistry, biology, DMPK and relevant technology functions to develop and test new therapeutic concepts. Bringing these perspectives together early helps the team make clear, evidence-based decisions at pace.

**What You Can Expect Here

**You will have the opportunity to shape the research of a new team and contribute your own ideas, in an environment that values thoughtful scientific challenge, collaboration and learning from unexpected findings.

Summary

Please note this internship will be a minimum of three months, you must be enrolled as a student on a PhD course and available to start no later than 1st June 2027

Within Apple’s Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning organization (AIML), you can take part in the ongoing revolution that machine learning plays in daily life. Apple’s fully-integrated hardware and software provide unique opportunities to deliver amazing experiences, all while prioritizing user privacy. As an AIML intern, you will get to explore new methods, apply machine learning to solve ambitious problems, advance state-of-the art technology through research and publications, challenge existing metrics or protocols, and develop new theories that will impact the way we understand machine learning and the experiences it can enable. Come collaborate with some of the best in the business and help build the world's most innovative products and experiences.

Description

In an AIML internship, you will collaborate with researchers, engineers, and program/project managers to tackle innovative challenges. You will also receive technical mentorship and guidance that allows you to learn new things every day, gain practical skills, build real world experience, develop a greater understanding of our industry, and form valuable connections. Together, you and your team will partner to design and implement an innovative solution for a Machine Learning problem that is meaningful. At the end of your internship, you will have the opportunity to meet and present your work to AIML leadership. Where appropriate, you will have the opportunity to submit your work for publication at a suitable conference.

We are offering a research internship opportunity to work directly with our research team in Copenhagen, Denmark on projects ranging from multilingual automatic speech recognition (ASR) to multilingual speech language models (SpeechLMs). The internship topic can be fitted to the candidate's interests, with example topics including language interference and cross-lingual transfer, the effect of training data composition on multilingual generalization, low-resource languages and dialects, efficient adaptation and continual learning, self-supervised and multimodal learning, and interpretability of multilingual speech models.

Minimum Qualifications

• Working towards a doctoral degree in computer science, engineering, data science, applied mathematics, cognitive science, computational linguistics or equivalent.

• In-depth knowledge of deep learning and statistical machine learning, with strong Python programming skills and experience with ML libraries such as PyTorch or TensorFlow

• Research experience in multilingual or cross-lingual speech and language processing, such as ASR, speech LMs, or audio language models

• Interest in Speech and Language Processing

• Strong demonstrable record of publishing academic research in ML-related peer-reviewed venues (NeurIPS, ICLR, ICML...), including language- and speech-specific ones (e.g. *ACL, Interspeech, ICASSP)

• Ability to collaborate with others and to deliver ML technologies aligned with Apple's core values: the highest standards of quality, scientific rigour, innovation, and respect for user privacy

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience training or fine-tuning large speech or language models

• Experience with language interference, cross-lingual transfer, or low-resource languages and dialects

• Interest in the interpretability and efficient adaptation of speech models

jobs.occupation: Assistant Professors in Electronic Systems (with the possibility of tenure-track)
jobs.description:
At the Technical Faculty of IT and Design, Department of Electronic Systems, one or more positions as Assistant Professor in Electronic Systems are open for appointments from June 1, 2027, or soon after. The positions are available for a period of 4 years (with the possibility of tenure-track). The positions are with the department's research groups located at the university campus in Copenhagen.

Your profile and work tasks
We seek to appoint one or more Assistant Professors (with the possibility of Tenure-Track) to conduct research, teaching, and knowledge exchange, and to grow and develop the department's research activities within our subject fields.

The positions require internationally recognized research experience within one or more of the following areas:

• Cyber security
• Privacy engineering
• Computer Systems
• Edge/cloud computing
• High-Performance Computing (HPC)
• Data Engineering
• Big Data Infrastructure
• Machine Learning Systems
The main tasks and responsibilities include:

• developing a research profile and providing valuable contributions to science.
• providing research-based teaching and supervision within at least one subject area.
• participating in grant application activities
• coordinating own projects and contributing to an active academic environment
Your competencies
You have an interest in collaborating with external partners and experience from participating in grant applications. You have also contributed to workplace well-being, collaboration, equal treatment, diversity, and a good working environment.

Selected candidates should demonstrate development potential in science and have peer-reviewed publications in recognized journals and books or anthologies. Under the leadership of others, you can plan and carry out individual teaching and supervision activities with a focus on the students' learning.

Who we are
In electronic engineering, Aalborg University is known worldwide for its high academic quality and societal impact. The Department of Electronic Systems employs more than 200 people, of which about 90 are PhD students, and about 40 % of all employees are internationals. In total, it has more than 700 students in its BSc and MSc programs, which are based on AAU's problem-based learning model. 

The department leverages its unique research infrastructure and lab facilities to conduct world-leading fundamental and applied research within communication, networks, control systems, AI, sound, cyber security, and robotics. The department plays an active role in transferring inventions and results into applications in close collaboration with industrial partners worldwide. 

The department places significant emphasis on supporting early career researchers and provides comprehensive career and personal development programmes, specifically designed to assist individual academics in achieving their professional objectives.

You can read more about the department at www.es.aau.dk.

Qualification requirements
Appointment as Assistant Professor requires academic qualifications at PhD level.

Tenure-track
When appointing tenure track assistant professors, Aalborg University also place particular emphasis on:

• The candidate can demonstrate a high degree of autonomy in their previous education and employment path
• The candidate shows considerable potential and is among the best in their field
• The candidate has academic experience from several universities and/or research institutions and preferably international experience
• The candidate is a skilled communicator
• The candidate writes and speaks English at the academic level
• The candidate is expected to meet the criteria for permanent employment as an associate professor at Aalborg University at the end of the tenure track process
Evaluation and promotion proces:

• Annual internal follow-ups to review progress on the promotion plan and ensure the assistant professor remains on track.
• A mid-term evaluation, based on external review, conducted by an internal assessment committee after three years.
• A final review by an external committee after 5.5 years. A positive outcome leads to a tenured appointment as Associate Professor.
• Assessment in connection with transfer to associate professorship 
Assessment in connection with transfer to associate professorship
The assessment in connection with transition to tenure as an associate professor normally takes place in the final six months of the tenure track assistant professors’ employment. However, the employee may request that an assessment take place at an earlier time in the first four years. If this assessment finds that the employee is not academically qualified, they may request another assessment within the final six months of their period of employment. A maximum of two assessments may take place. 

The assessment, on transition to the associate professorship, will as a minimum, emphasize the following qualifications in relation to the scientific subject area of the tenure track assistant professorship: 

• Research qualifications equivalent to the level that can be achieved on the basis of satisfactorily completed employment as tenure track assistant professor.
• Documented scientific production at international level. Assessment will be based on up to ten selected publications selected by the employee.
• Documentation of pedagogical supervision and upgrading of qualifications, including a positive written assessment of teaching qualifications. The assessment will also be based on the employee's teaching portfolio.
• The level of contribution to an active academic environment as well as the ability to collaborate and build relationships.
• The level of experience with grant proposals and experience of communicating research to relevant stakeholders. 
If the tenure track assistant professor fails to request that their qualifications be assessed in the last year of their period of employment or if they are assessed as not academically qualified, the university must immediately initiate dismissal proceedings in accordance with the collective agreement rules. 

How to apply  
Your application must include the following: 

• Application, stating reasons for applying, qualifications in relation to the position, and intentions and visions for the position 
• Curriculum Vitae (CV) 
• Diplomas (master's degree diploma and PhD diploma) 
• List of publications, with an indication of the attached publications that you wish to be taken into account in the assessment. You may attach a maximum of five publications. 
• Documentation of teaching qualifications. Please see guidelines for teaching portfolio at The Technical Faculty of IT and Design. If this is not enclosed, the applicant must enclose the reasons for this .
• Dissemination qualifications, including participation on committees or boards, participation in organisations etc. 
• Additional qualifications in relation to the position 
• References/recommendations 
You can read more about the requirements for your application here.    

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website.  

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position. 

Aalborg University has a policy of parallel language use. The successful applicant is expected, with support from the university, to acquire Danish language skills over time and to be able to contribute to teaching in Danish within 2–5 years of employment, including grading and supervising students, at a level corresponding to the teaching undertaken.

Danish language courses will be offered as part of the employment.

Do you have any questions? 
If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.     

 Further information 
Read more about our recruitment process here   

The appointment process at Aalborg University involves a shortlisting process. You can read more about the shortlisting and appointment process here.  

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace. 

Salary and terms of employment  
The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities. Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement) and protocol on certain terms of employment of academic staff at universities.

You can find information about the salary and salary structure for the position in the Salary Overview for Recruitment - Scientific positions (VIP). Please refer to the introductory section of the page and the section entitled “Tenure track assistant professor/Tenure track researcher”.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the world
Aalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.

Chief Commercial Officer (CCO)

Location: On site (Denmark, near Værløse, 20 min NW of central Copenhagen)

Reporting to: Chief Executive Officer (CEO)

Shape the Commercial Future of a High-Tech Drone Defense Company

UMag Solutions is a rapidly growing defence technology company developing and manufacturing advanced Quantum Magnetic Sensing payloads for Autonomous Systems for military, government, and allied customers around the world. Our solutions are used for land- and naval min detection as well as anti-submarine warfare.

Today, we are a team of approximately 45 highly skilled professionals. Over the next three years, we expect to triple our organization and establish subsidiaries in key international markets. This growth requires a commercial leader who can build not only business, but also the organization, leadership, and commercial capabilities needed for an internationally recognized defense company.

We are therefore seeking a visionary Chief Commercial Officer (CCO) to join our Executive Management Team.

This is a unique opportunity to influence the strategic direction of the company while building and scaling-up a world-class commercial organization that supports our continued international expansion.

The Opportunity

As Chief Commercial Officer, you will be responsible for executing the company's commercial strategy and leading all customer-facing functions throughout the customer lifecycle.

You will lead the Commercial Organization through four experienced functional leaders:

• Sales

• Marketing

• Technical Solutions, Support & Partnerships

• Operations & Logistics

Together, these departments are responsible for creating market awareness, developing business opportunities, managing customer and drone-partner relationships, planning and executing customer demonstrations worldwide, delivering products, managing customer support and training, and ensuring long-term customer success.

Your mission is to align these functions into one integrated commercial organization capable of supporting international growth while maintaining operational excellence and exceptional customer experience.

As a member of the Executive Management Team, you will work closely with the CEO and fellow executives to shape company strategy, drive growth, and ensure the organization is prepared for its next stage of development.

Commercial Leadership

• Execute the company's commercial strategy in alignment with the corporate strategy.

• Lead and develop the Commercial Leadership Team.

• Create alignment across all customer-facing functions.

• Establish a culture focused on customer success and sustainable growth.

• Build the commercial organization required to support international expansion.

• Develop strategic customer relationships.

• Lead commercial planning and sales forecasting.

• Strengthen opportunity management and pipeline quality.

• Support major negotiations and strategic customer engagements.

• Improve commercial processes and performance.

• Strengthen the company's international market position.

• Develop marketing strategies supporting business growth.

• Build brand awareness within the global defense sector.

• Oversee product positioning, communications, digital marketing, and industry events.

• Ensure marketing activities generate measurable commercial value.

• Develop scalable E-learning and physical training material for all products.

• Develop and strengthen long-term customer, drone and re-seller partner relationships.

• Support all commercial functions (sales, marketing, operations, support) with relevant advanced technical information when needed

• Improve customer satisfaction and retention.

• Establish scalable customer support processes

• Ensure world-class after-sales support.

• Develop service offerings supporting recurring business.

Operations & Logistics

Through the Head of Operations, Support & Logistics, you will:

• Make sure that our operation team members and other employees are up-to-speed on products before going on product demonstrations or tradeshows

• Oversee commercial logistics related to demonstrations and customer deliveries.

• Ensure timely and compliant international shipment of products.

• Continuously improve customer-facing operational processes.

• Coordinate testing of prototype hardware and software solutions before stable releases

Strategic Responsibilities

As the company scales, you will play a key role in building the commercial organization of the future.

This includes:

• Designing scalable commercial structures and governance.

• Developing commercial KPIs and performance management.

• Building leadership capabilities throughout the commercial organization.

• Supporting the establishment of international subsidiaries.

• Standardizing commercial processes across multiple locations.

• Driving cross-functional collaboration between Sales, Marketing, Customer Support, Operations, Engineering, Production, Finance, and Product Management.

• Supporting strategic partnerships, international market expansion, and long-term growth initiatives.

Who You Are

You are an experienced and fast-moving commercial executive who combines strategic thinking with operational excellence.

You are not afraid of using and implementing AI wherever it makes sense in the commercial organization.

You have successfully built and led commercial organizations during periods of rapid growth and understand how to create structure without losing agility.

You thrive in environments where you can influence strategy while remaining close to execution.

Most importantly, you enjoy developing people, building strong leadership teams, and creating organizations capable of sustained international growth.

Qualifications

We expect you to bring:

• A university degree in Business, Engineering, Military Studies, or a related field.

• Significant senior commercial leadership experience, preferably as a Chief Commercial Officer, Senior Business Developer, Commercial Director, VP Commercial, or similar executive role.

• Experience from a high-tech product company, preferably within defense, aerospace, or advanced manufacturing.

• Demonstrated success scaling commercial organizations in a growing company.

• Experience leading leaders and developing management teams.

• Strong understanding of complex B2G and B2B sales environments.

• Experience with international customers and government procurement processes.

• Strong commercial, financial, and strategic business acumen.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

International travel should be expected to partner companies, product demonstrations and tradeshows.

What Success Looks Like

Within your first years, you will have:

• Strengthened collaboration across all customer-facing functions.

• Positioned the company as a preferred partner within the international defense and drone industry.

• Built an integrated, high-performing commercial organization.

• Implemented AI in all relevant processes

• Improved commercial forecasting and governance.

• Increased customer satisfaction.

• Established scalable commercial processes capable of supporting continued growth beyond 100 employees.

• Supported successful international expansion.

Why Join Us?

This is more than a traditional commercial leadership role.

You will join a fast-moving and highly innovative tech company at a defining moment in its journey—from an innovative scale-up to an internationally recognized defense technology company backed by the Bridgepoint Group.

As a member of the Executive Management Team, you will have significant influence on our strategic direction, organizational development, and international growth. You will work alongside talented colleagues who are passionate about delivering advanced capabilities to customers operating in some of the world's most demanding environments.

If you are motivated by building organizations, developing leaders, and creating commercial excellence in a high-growth international tech business, we would like to hear from you.
